history.summary: Low-floor 990sqft 3BR in the CanningHill sequel at $2.612M/$2,638psf — the developer's own 2026-repriced schedule price for fl 01-10, ~13% below launch, sitting inside (not above) the completed-neighbour resale band. Genuine relative value for an uncompleted RCR unit; capped by a 43% developer overhang, a nearby launch wave, ~3.2% yield, and the weakest floor position in the tower.
history.rating_rationale: The price is honest but the position is weak and the umbrella is falling, not rising. Value: at $2,638psf this uncompleted 3BR enters BELOW CanningHill ($3,228), Riviere ($2,903) and Martin Modern's 3BR band ($2,792) resales on the same area basis — rare for a new launch and the strongest point in its favour; RCR fwd prior (+3.1%/yr) beats the CCR alternative. Against it: the discount exists because demand failed at launch pricing — the developer cut ~13% in Q2-2026 and still holds ~158 units, so for years every resale competes with developer stock plus four fresh launches nearby; the 990-type's own launch buyer (fl 31-35, $3,292, Jul-25) is already ~13% underwater against the May-26 schedule; yield ~3.2% misses the 3.5% fallback line; no income until ~2029-30 TOP pushes the realistic exit to 2031-34 (yrs 5-8); and fl 01-10 above a retail/hotel podium is the tower's weakest resale position with no extra discount for it (ask is ON the floor curve). Within-project, fl 16-25 at $2,751-2,800psf is the better ticket for +$110-160k. Vs Dunearn House C1 (Neutral, $2,978psf harmonised, CCR): USR is ~7% cheaper per liveable sqft with 12% more space and better region/transit — on pure numbers this is the stronger of the two Neutrals; on momentum and overhang it is the weaker. Not a Buy: the value cushion is compensation for the overhang, not an edge.
red_flags: Developer overhang: ~43% unsold (158 units) 20 months post-launch, after a ~13% Q2-2026 repricing — multi-year cap on resale pricing
Launch-buyer cohort underwater: Jul-25 990sqft print $3,292psf vs May-26 same-band $2,888 — the project's first prints are marked down, poor comp optics at exit
Low floor (inferred 01-10) above mixed-use retail+hotel podium; Clarke Quay nightlife noise; weakest position on a $260psf floor curve with zero positional discount
Est gross yield ~3.2% < 3.5% fallback line; zero income until TOP (~2029-30; Mar-2031 contractual)
Supply wave: River Green / Robertson Opus / Promenade Peak / Zion Residences (2025-26) compete for the same exit buyer and tenant
$2.612M quantum above the $2.2M deep-liquidity knee; floor/stack unverified from listing (confirm before offer)
catalysts: Enters below completed-neighbour resale band (CanningHill $3,228 / Riviere $2,903) on the same area basis — uncompleted product at completed-resale pricing
RCR (URA-confirmed) +3.1%/yr realized forward baseline; 3 MRT stations walkable incl. Clarke Quay 274m; within 1km River Valley Primary
SDI-linked CanningHill/Union Square precinct upgrade + Singapore River rejuvenation; 28-unit 3BR cohort is genuinely scarce within the project
Post-repricing velocity is real: 11 of 28 990sqft 3BRs sold Mar-May 2026 — the cut found the market-clearing level
